name: Step Families
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred union of marriage as a man leaves his parents to become one flesh with his wife, establishing a new family unit (Genesis 2:24). Honor and respect for parents remain foundational, even as families blend and grow (Exodus 20:12; Proverbs 1:8). The commitment to serve the Lord as a household guides the spiritual unity and purpose within the family (Joshua 24:15), while recognizing children as a divine blessing entrusted to parents (Psalms 127:3). The joy and goodness of living together in harmony underscore the importance of unity in all family relationships (Psalms 133:1).
